notes.title: Beach Club Simulator 2024 Update V0.3.0
notes.content:
Greetings everyone, summer is coming. 🌴 🌞 🏖️ 

This year we are not spending money on vacation and we are building our own beach club. 🚀

In order to provide a more realistic and fun experience to our valued players, we have prepared a graphical improvement. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911428/212a1e3765757661d7cfb25a4bfa5a40740f1056.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44911428/e930f4cafcfb68eb539db6d6e2abc1a990c587ba.png

In addition, we fixed some bugs and made changes in the game economy. Thank you very much for your feedback. Have fun! 🌞 🏖️  🌴

-Graphic improvements!
-Balance of game economy!
-Bug fix!
-Optimization!

notes.title: Beach Club Simulator 2024 Patch version 0.2.7
notes.content:
Update Notes
-Chief waiter added to the Employees menu.

-Shopping order limit increased to 20.

-Game economy balance.

-Car handling has been improved.

-Bug fix.

-Optimization.

notes.title: Beach Club Simulator 2024 v0.2.6 Update
notes.content:
Greetings to everyone, 

I hope you're in a good mood!

Beach Club Simulator 2024 version 0.2.6 update released. 

Have a good time.

Update Notes
-Jetski has been added for NPCs. Now, after purchasing the pool area, customers will want to ride the jetski for a fee. Of course, NPCs don't know how to use a jetski. You will have to use it  

-Car driving has been improved. 

-Improved NPC behavior system. 

-Bug fixing.

notes.title: Beach Club Simulator 2024 Update V0.2.0
notes.content:
Greetings to everyone, 👋 

Summer is coming! I hope you're in a good mood!🌴 🌞 🏖️ 

Beach Club Simulator 2024 version 0.2.0 update released. 🚀 

Have a good time.🎉 

Update notes
-Added a boat trip to the marina. You will now be able to organize a boat tour once a day for 2000 dollars. Profit will increase according to level.🛥️ 🌴 

-You will be able to go to the island with your own boat and search for valuable treasure.🏴‍☠️ 🪙 

-Bug fix🛠️
